name: Obadiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Ahab called Obadiah, governor of his house, who feared the Lord greatly; when Jezebel cut off the prophets of the Lord, Obadiah took an hundred prophets and hid them by fifty in a cave and fed them with bread and water, putting his own life in danger to save them.

note.label: 1 Kings 18: The Lord, He Is the God

points: The famine was so sore it was hitting the animals, so Ahab and Obadiah divided the land between them, each going his own way to seek fountains and brooks to find grass to save the horses and mules alive. This was the fruit of the drought Elijah had pronounced.

note.label: 1 Kings 18: The Lord, He Is the God

points: As Obadiah went his way, Elijah met him; Obadiah fell on his face and said, Art thou my lord Elijah? Elijah told him to go tell Ahab that Elijah is here.

note.label: 1 Kings 18: The Lord, He Is the God
